dct_description_sm: The Parking Area polygon feature class within the City of Kingston is used as part of the rendering of the City of Kingston Basemap, Community Map Project, General Presentation, General Analysis. It represents the driven portion of a private or public parking area (not to be confused with a parking lot, which is a separate feature class). Paved, Unpaved, Material Type. This data is updated with the most recent Imagery (Nearmap) acquisition (Spring/Fall. It is for this reason that the feature class can not be considered complete in nature.
